findings: [CAUSE] MODERN-STANDBY x3 enter event(s) in window -- host was in S0 low-power idle. STANDBYIDLE=Never on AC does NOT prevent this; do not read a clean STANDBYIDLE as evidence the host stayed awake.

[CAUSE] SCHEDULER-COLD-START x2 at 08-13 10:50:46, 08-13 23:17:18 -- a cold Initialized means the app process did not exist before that moment. The scheduler cannot dispatch a slot that falls while the process is absent, and Claude Desktop does not auto-start after a reboot.
